parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
attorney[əˈtɜːrni]n.
An attorney is one who gives others advice about the law.
→ The attorney appeared in front of the judge for me.
😎
chronic[ˈkrɑːnɪk]adj.
When something is chronic, it happens over and over again over time.
→ He had chronic pain in his chest and needed to see a doctor.
😎
discipline[ˈdɪsəplɪn]n.
Discipline is training that helps people follow the rules.
→ One of the teacher’s jobs is to teach her students discipline.
😎
donor[ˈdoʊnər]n.
A donor is somebody who gives something to an organization.
→ He was proud to be a blood donor.
😎
fellow[ˈfeloʊ]n.
A fellow is someone who shares a job or quality with someone else.
→ All of my fellow patients at the hospital have also complained about the food.
😎
gossip[ˈɡɑːsɪp]n.
Gossip is information that might be untrue but is still discussed anyway.
→ The friends exchanged gossip about the people they knew in school.
😎
graduate[ˈɡrædʒueɪt]v.
To graduate from a school means to complete and pass all courses of study there.
→ At the end of the spring, my friends and I will graduate from high school.
😎
graffiti[ɡrəˈfiːti]n.
Graffiti is words or drawings in public places.
→ The wall was covered with colorful graffiti.
😎
guardian[ˈɡɑːrdiən]n.
A guardian is someone who protects somebody or something.
→ The librarians are the guardians of the books.
😎
implicate[ˈɪmplɪkeɪt]v.
To implicate someone is to show that they have done a crime or something bad.
→ The man was implicated in the theft at the store.
😎
kin[kɪn]n.
Kin is a person’s family and relatives.
→ His kin were all farmers.
😎
referee[ˌrefəˈriː]n.
A referee is a person who makes sure that the rules are followed in sports.
→ The soccer player didn’t agree with the referee.
😎
sever[ˈsevər]v.
To sever something is to cut through it completely.
→ He severed the string using scissors.
😎
shaft[ʃæft]n.
A shaft is a handle of a tool or weapon.
→ The golf club had a long wooden shaft that he held in his hands.
😎
stab[stæb]v.
To stab means to cut someone or something with a sharp object like a knife.
→ He stabbed the fork into the potato and passed it to his daughter.
😎
stimulus[ˈstɪmjələs]n.
A stimulus is something that causes growth or activity.
→ Having a lot of money is a stimulus for people to buy more things.
😎
suspicion[səˈspɪʃn]n.
A suspicion is a feeling that something is possible or true in a crime.
→ The police had a suspicion that the driver had stolen the purse.
😎
terminate[ˈtɜːrmɪneɪt]v.
To terminate something means to stop or end it.
→ The trip was terminated after the car broke down.
😎
theme[θiːm]n.
A theme is the main subject of a book, movie, or painting.
→ The students discussed the book’s theme in class.
😎
tuition[tuˈɪʃn]n.
Tuition is the amount of money paid to go to a school.
→ University tuitions have increased by fifty percent in the last five years.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: Which is a place that you would graduate from?
questions.explanation: "graduate from" (tốt nghiệp từ) thường kết hợp với trường học (school).

questions.content: Which of the following has a shaft?
questions.explanation: "shaft" (trục, tay cầm) là bộ phận của gậy bi-a (pool stick).

questions.content: What is one responsibility of a referee?
options: To make sure a game is fair
questions.explanation: "referee" (trọng tài) có trách nhiệm đảm bảo trận đấu công bằng.

questions.content: Why might somebody hire an attorney?
options: To prove they didn't do a crime
To help them decorate their home
questions.explanation: "attorney" (luật sư) được thuê để chứng minh sự trong sạch (prove they didn't do a crime).

questions.content: How would you describe chronic pain?
options: It hurts only when it is cold.
questions.explanation: "chronic" (mãn tính, kéo dài) nghĩa là đau liên tục trong thời gian dài.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the one that is similar in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: kin
questions.explanation: "kin" (người thân) tương đương với relatives.

questions.content: chronic
questions.explanation: "chronic" (mãn tính, liên tục) tương đương với constant.

questions.content: attorney
questions.explanation: "attorney" (luật sư) tương đương với lawyer.

questions.content: gossip
questions.explanation: "gossip" (lời đồn) tương đương với an untrue talk.

questions.content: sever
questions.explanation: "sever" (cắt đứt) tương đương với to cut off.

questions.content: stab
questions.explanation: "stab" (đâm, cắt) tương đương với to cut.

questions.content: theme
questions.explanation: "theme" (chủ đề, ý chính) tương đương với a main idea.

questions.content: suspicion
questions.explanation: "suspicion" (sự nghi ngờ) tương đương với mistrust.

questions.content: guardian
questions.explanation: "guardian" (người bảo vệ) tương đương với a protector.

questions.content: terminate
questions.explanation: "terminate" (chấm dứt) tương đương với to end.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.

questions.content: Mr. Wilson _______ from the university over 15 years ago.
questions.explanation: "graduated" (tốt nghiệp) phù hợp với ngữ cảnh từ trường đại học (university).

questions.content: He has always been a generous _______ and wants to improve the school.
questions.explanation: "donor" (người hiến tặng) phù hợp với tính từ generous (hào phóng).

questions.content: The university recently decreased its _______.
questions.explanation: "tuition" (học phí) phù hợp với việc giảm chi phí tại trường đại học.

questions.content: It was supposed to be a _______ for more students to study there.
questions.explanation: "stimulus" (động lực) giúp thu hút thêm sinh viên đến học thuật.

questions.content: Laurie was _______ in a terrible thing.
questions.explanation: "implicated" (dính líu) vào một việc tồi tệ (a terrible thing).

questions.content: She was caught leaving _______ on the school wall.
questions.explanation: "graffiti" (hình vẽ bậy) trên bức tường trường học (school wall).

questions.content: Elliot had _______ problems at school.
questions.explanation: "chronic problems" (vấn đề mãn tính, kéo dài) ở trường học.

questions.content: His parents decided to show more _______.
questions.explanation: "discipline" (kỷ luật) được phụ huynh áp dụng để giáo dục con cái.

questions.content: Hannah was tired of hearing _______ about her neighbors.
questions.explanation: "gossip" (lời đồn) về những người hàng xóm (neighbors).

questions.content: She decided to _______ that behavior and think about better things.
questions.explanation: "terminate" (chấm dứt) hành vi đó (that behavior).

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write Correct if the italicized word is used correctly. Write Incorrect if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: I may not be able to go to college next year. I don’t have enough money for tuition.
questions.explanation: "tuition" (học phí) dùng chính xác khi nói về tiền học đại học.

questions.content: The boy’s parents didn’t know how to control him. They taught him discipline.
questions.explanation: "didn't know how to control" (không biết cách kiểm soát) mâu thuẫn với việc đã dạy "discipline" (kỷ luật). Dùng sai.

questions.content: He was a donor. He received gifts from people all of the time.
questions.explanation: "donor" (người hiến tặng) mâu thuẫn với "received gifts" (nhận quà). Dùng sai.

questions.content: His new stove will be a stimulus for him to cook at home more often.
questions.explanation: "stimulus" (động lực) dùng chính xác cho việc khích lệ nấu ăn.

questions.content: Ellen didn’t like the color of her walls, so she painted graffiti on them.
questions.explanation: "graffiti" (vẽ bậy nơi công cộng) không dùng để chỉ việc sơn lại tường nhà. Dùng sai.

questions.content: Jason was implicated in the bank robbery. Several people saw him do it.
questions.explanation: "implicated" (bị dính líu, bị cáo buộc) dùng chính xác trong ngữ cảnh vụ cướp ngân hàng.

questions.content: Besides her parents, Olivia had no other kin. She only had one sister.
questions.explanation: "kin" (người thân) mâu thuẫn với việc có một người em gái (sister). Dùng sai.

questions.content: The gardener picked up the tool by the shaft. It was easiest to hold that way.
questions.explanation: "shaft" (cán, tay cầm) dùng chính xác cho công cụ làm vườn.

questions.content: The man was sent to prison for stabbing someone. The person was hurt but survived.
questions.explanation: "stabbing" (đâm) dùng chính xác trong tội phạm gây thương tích.

questions.content: The theme of the book was forgiveness.
questions.explanation: "theme" (chủ đề) dùng chính xác cho sách.

questions.content: Leslie’s father is a policeman. He is a guardian of crime.
questions.explanation: "guardian of crime" (người bảo vệ tội phạm) là sai, cảnh sát bảo vệ pháp luật. Dùng sai.

questions.content: I took a knife and severed the line from the pole to the fish’s mouth.
questions.explanation: "severed" (cắt đứt) dùng chính xác khi dùng dao cắt dây.

questions.content: The food was being held on suspicion of committing two crimes in the city.
questions.explanation: "suspicion" (nghi ngờ) về việc phạm tội không thể dùng cho đồ ăn (food). Dùng sai.

questions.content: I spoke to my fellow teachers, and we all agreed to support the students at the rally.
questions.explanation: "fellow" (đồng nghiệp) dùng chính xác khi nói về giáo viên khác.

questions.content: The referee said the player had broken the rules.
questions.explanation: "referee" (trọng tài) dùng chính xác trong thể thao.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
"I Didn't Do It!"

Billy was in big trouble. The day before, a donor gave the school a painting with a sports theme. It showed a referee congratulating two athletes. The principal hung the painting in front of the office, hoping that it would be a stimulus for students to play sports. The next morning, however, the painting was destroyed. There was graffiti on it, and it had many holes in it. The worst part was that one of Billy's fellow students said she thought she saw Billy do it!

But Billy didn't do it. The principal called Billy's parents and said, "Billy won't tell us the truth. He's a chronic liar, and he ruined the painting. If you don't pay for it, we'll terminate his education here."

Billy's parents didn't have enough money to pay for the painting and for his tuition. But Billy's parents had an idea. That afternoon, they went to see Mr. Meyers, an attorney.

"Mr. Meyers, my son has been implicated in a crime he says he didn't do," Billy's father said. "Everybody believes the gossip. Even some of our own kin think he did it!"

"I believe you. My suspicion is that the tape from the security cameras will show who really did it," said Mr. Meyers.

The next day, Mr. Meyers received a packet with the videotape from the school. It showed another student who resembled Billy walking up to the painting and writing on it. Then the student took a knife by the shaft and started to stab large holes in it. Finally, he severed the rope that held up the painting, and it fell to the floor.

Mr. Meyers showed the tape to the principal. "Clearly, that's not Billy," he said. "This boy is actually responsible and needs some discipline."

Billy was happy that someone believed him. He said to Mr. Meyers, "When I graduate and go to university, I will major in law, so I can be a guardian of justice like you!"

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True or False.

questions.content: A donor gave the school a painting with a sports theme as a stimulus for students to play sports.
questions.explanation: Hiệu trưởng (principal) mới là người treo bức tranh như một động lực (stimulus) cho sinh viên, không phải người hiến tặng (donor).

questions.content: The painting showed a referee congratulating two athletes.
questions.explanation: Bức tranh vẽ một trọng tài đang chúc mừng hai vận động viên.

questions.content: Billy was implicated in the crime because a fellow student received a packet with a videotape showing him doing it.
questions.explanation: Billy bị dính líu vì một bạn học (fellow student) nói rằng cô ấy nghĩ đã nhìn thấy cậu làm việc đó, không phải do cuộn băng.

questions.content: Everybody gossiped about Billy, and even some of our kin think he did it.
questions.explanation: Mọi người đồn đoán (gossiped) và thậm chí một số người thân (kin) cũng nghĩ cậu ta làm.

questions.content: The principal threatened to terminate Billy’s education if his parents didn’t pay his tuition.
questions.explanation: Hiệu trưởng đe dọa chấm dứt học tập nếu cha mẹ không trả tiền cho bức tranh (pay for the painting), không phải học phí (tuition).

questions.content: What did the principal say about Billy?
options: That he was a chronic liar
That he had a lot of discipline
questions.explanation: Hiệu trưởng nói rằng Billy là một kẻ nói dối mãn tính (chronic liar).

questions.content: What was Mr. Meyers’ suspicion?
options: That the tape from the security cameras would show who really did the crime
That the tuition was too high
questions.explanation: Sự nghi ngờ (suspicion) của ông Meyers là đoạn băng từ camera an ninh sẽ cho thấy ai thực sự làm việc đó.

questions.content: What did the videotape show?
options: Another boy leaving graffiti, stabbing it, and severing the string
questions.explanation: Đoạn băng cho thấy một cậu bé khác đang vẽ bậy, đâm (stab) bức tranh và cắt đứt (sever) sợi dây.

questions.content: What did the attorney suggest to the principal about the boy responsible for the crime?
options: That he should be a fellow student
That he was a chronic liar
That he should pay the tuition
questions.explanation: Luật sư gợi ý rằng cậu bé thực sự chịu trách nhiệm cần phải được rèn kỷ luật (discipline).

questions.content: Why did Billy say he wanted his major to be law when he went to university?
options: So he could be a guardian of justice like Mr. Meyers
So he could be a referee
So he could sever the rope
questions.explanation: Billy muốn học luật để có thể trở thành người bảo vệ công lý (guardian of justice) giống như ông Meyers.
